title: Go: HTTP Middleware Pipeline
description: Build a composable HTTP middleware chain using Go's net/http package with logging, auth, and context propagation.

steps.title: Define the Middleware type
steps.description: Define a type `Middleware func(http.Handler) http.Handler`. Write a function `Wrap(handler http.Handler, middlewares ...Middleware) http.Handler` that applies middlewares in order. Print a confirmation using `fmt.Println`.
hints: Middleware takes a Handler and returns a Handler
Apply middlewares in reverse order (last wraps first)
http.HandlerFunc adapts a func to http.Handler

verification.successMessage: Middleware type defined and wrapping works!
verification.failureMessage: Print a message confirming the middleware chain was set up.

steps.title: Logging middleware
steps.description: Create a `LoggingMiddleware` that logs each request's method, path, and duration using `fmt.Printf`. Use `time.Now()` before calling `next.ServeHTTP` and `time.Since()` after. Format: `"GET /path took 1.2ms"`.
hints: Access request info via r.Method and r.URL.Path

verification.failureMessage: Print method, path, and duration for each request.

steps.title: Auth middleware
steps.description: Create an `AuthMiddleware` that checks for an `Authorization` header. If missing or not equal to `"Bearer secret-token"`, respond with `http.StatusUnauthorized` and a message. Otherwise call `next.ServeHTTP`. Print auth results using `fmt.Println`.
hints: Write error response with w.WriteHeader and w.Write
Return early without calling next on failure

verification.failureMessage: Print whether the request was authorized or unauthorized.

steps.title: Middleware chaining
steps.description: Compose a chain of three middlewares: `LoggingMiddleware`, `AuthMiddleware`, and a custom `RecoveryMiddleware` that recovers from panics. Apply them to a simple `helloHandler`. Print the chain order using `fmt.Println`.
hints: RecoveryMiddleware uses defer/recover inside a closure
Pass the final handler through Wrap
Print the middleware chain order before handling

verification.failureMessage: Print the middleware chain order and execution trace.

steps.title: Request-scoped context
steps.description: Create a `ContextMiddleware` that injects a request ID (UUID-like string) into `r.Context()` using `context.WithValue`. Define a custom type `ctxKey` to avoid collisions. The final handler retrieves the request ID and prints it with `fmt.Printf`.
hints: Define a private type for context keys to avoid collisions
Retrieve with r.Context().Value(key) in the handler

verification.failureMessage: Print the request ID injected via context.

steps.title: Rate limiter middleware
steps.description: Create a `RateLimitMiddleware` that limits requests using a token bucket (implemented with a channel of tokens). If a token is available, allow the request; otherwise respond with 429 Too Many Requests. Print rate limit stats using `fmt.Printf`.
hints: Use a buffered channel as the token bucket
A goroutine refills tokens on a ticker
Select on ctx.Done() or channel receive for timeout

verification.failureMessage: Print rate limit status for each request.
